document.about: HSE L118, Health and safety at quarries. Its outline lists the parts and regulations at one depth, under the booklet's title; each regulation sets `Regulation`, `ACOP`, `Guidance` and its topics in 12pt bold.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#456): read as a heading by its size, the line under the title opened a section holding the front matter or nothing. The title's subtitle is a `doco:Subtitle`, directly after the `doco:Title`, and opens no section.
2026-11-26 (#456): a kicker over the title was a paragraph like any other. It is a `doco:Paragraph` with evidence `kicker`, so a consumer can tell it from the body.

checks.issue: #456: the booklet's subtitle, the regulations it guides on, was a heading.
#456: the publisher's name over the title was a plain paragraph.
